headline: First EST-01 check: ASCEND and STRIKE both cleared the kill-line, whale and 7-day pool tests, but no ticket opened because the desk has no 7-day-old holder count for either (holder baselines logged today; first checkable run Nov 8). Biggest move found: Wobbly Kiwi bought ~25.2k STRIKE for ~52.4k ADA between 8:04 and 8:28 AM ET. Grumpy Walrus net-bought ~28.9k ADA of ASCEND over 72h and has been quiet since the 6:11 PM MOGE buy. ASCEND side ~1.074M (-6.9% 24h), STRIKE ~1.189M, COCK ~146.5k (under its 150k line, Pass). No SW-01 ticket; ANAKIN and MOGE gates are due Nov 2.
learned: Lessons: the 7 PM EST-01 check needs a logged holder count from 7 days earlier, so the desk now logs on-chain holder-address counts for ASCEND and STRIKE in cardano_top10 every daily run (baseline Nov 1: 866 and 3,610).

Changed: Wobbly Kiwi moved to the whales list after a ~52.4k ADA STRIKE buy that the prefilter missed (STRIKE was capped in liquidity_moves). dev_checks: 16 rows, 0 complete, 10 skipped (partial). Solana-side snipe candidate: none (closest CORE, unchanged).
